versions.notes:
32 a side, a reworked M32 and typing on the Steam Deck.

- Every map is bigger, made for 32 a side: five flags across a wider front, with an outpost on each flank (a logging camp, a radio relay, a mud-house hamlet, checkpoints, a radar site, a hangar yard, a farmstead, bridges over Timberline's river, dockside depots at Port Anvil), and deployments further back behind an approach of cover, forward posts and tree lines.
- Bots go up to 32 a side (16 by default), tickets up to 1200. Dedicated servers run 32 a side by default, the official server too.
- M32: the frame swings open to the side, each grenade goes into the chamber beside the barrel and the cylinder winds round to the next one. Its red dot sight is no longer blocked.
- Steam Deck: the on-screen keyboard types into the game's text boxes (server address, sign-in) and opens by itself when you pick one. Enter joins from the address box.
- Servers must be 0.1.4 too: the maps changed, so a 0.1.3 game and a 0.1.4 server build different worlds.
- Known: with your whole side in view at the deployment the frame rate dips for the first seconds of a 32-a-side match; a rocket can now and then pass through a soldier who has only just spawned.

Accounts, a server list and an official server.

- Accounts: sign in or make one from the title screen (top right) or at https://129-80-83-173.sslip.io. Your account name is your name on every scoreboard; without one you play as Guest and a number.
- Servers: a new page on the title screen lists every running dedicated server with its map and players, and joins in one click. Dedicated servers list themselves; a hosted game can be listed from the match setup.
- Official server: Frontface official (US East) is up for signed-in players.
- The scoreboard fits a full server: rows shrink to fit, and past about 30 a side it scrolls with the mouse wheel.
- Aim over cover, launchers with real ballistics and bigger blasts, flush M203 and GP-25 underbarrel launchers with their own sight, a side-mounted Kobra, and reticles you choose per class.
- Bots move as squads and go for the flags first.
- Known issue: a bot crouched right behind a wall can poke its rifle muzzle through it.

Resolution fix.

- The Resolution list under Settings > Graphics uses the monitor's real size, the same one the full-screen fix snaps back to (Proton on the Steam Deck reported a wrong size).
- Everything from 0.1.1: the native Linux / Steam Deck build and the full-screen fix for Proton.

Frontface for the Steam Deck and Linux, and a full-screen fix.

- Native Linux / Steam Deck build: install it with the Frontface Launcher AppImage (no Proton needed). Windows and Deck players can join each other's servers.
- Full screen at the wrong shape (side bars under Proton) now snaps back to the monitor's size.
- Display (full screen or windowed) and Resolution settings under Settings > Graphics.
- Controller mapping for Linux.

First build through the launcher.

- Conquest on six maps against bots or other players, with your own classes.
- Guns from every class's list, launchers, gadgets and killstreaks.
- Controller support, steady aim, stims for every class.
- Join a server by address from the launcher, or host one from the title screen.
